claims.claim: The diagnostic retains the fixed six targets, profile order, collection and execution checks, subject integrity checks, and worker isolation checks.
Known CorrectionIntegrationError message families map to bounded categories; unknown text maps to other without persisting raw wrapped detail.
Git and path observations use bounded labels and identities normalized across registered transient roots.
A fixed-target failure can expose at most one sanitized source locus matching its target file and a positive line number.
The cause validator accepts only the bounded schema and rejects unsafe loci, malformed identities, raw fields, and semantic decision fields.
The candidate remains within the three authorized diagnostic files. The 28 known-message cases now provide the required four-root diagnostic context while retaining their classification assertions.
